cancellation_summary: Reservations are non-refundable. Please provide Flagship with 24-hour notice prior to the cruise date to reschedule your cruise to another time and date.
meeting_point: 990 North Harbor Drive, San Diego, CA
pricing:
One-Way Ticket (Ages 4+): $9.00  
Infants (Ages 3 and under): Free
description:
Flagship Ferry is the most scenic way to cross San Diego Bay. Sail between downtown San Diego, the Coronado Ferry Landing, and the San Diego Convention Center while enjoying waterfront views, fresh bay breezes, and easy access to shopping, dining, and local attractions.

Coronado ferry tickets are valid for the purchased route and may be used on any scheduled departure, subject to vessel capacity. We recommend arriving at least 10 minutes prior to departure. During busy weekends, holidays, conferences, and special events, please allow extra time. Bicycles are welcome aboard at no additional charge, space permitting.

what_is_included_items.value: Great view of downtown San Diego skyline!
Dine and shop at Coronado Ferry Landing
Purchase tickets at any departure location
